title: B.A. in Japanese Studies
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 66 units (72 units with stream) of courses, as follows:

sections.title: Faculty Package
text: JASP1090* and any two courses from:

subsections.title: For Standard Scheme Only. Not for Local Study Scheme
text: Students are required to participate in one academic year (not less than eight calendar months) of resident study in Japan[c] and complete Japanese language and Japanese studies courses with prior approval from the Department of Japanese Studies before graduation. With the approval from the Department, students can apply to take the Local Study Scheme (see below) if they have strong justifications or when resident study in Japan is not possible due to unpredictable circumstances such as restrictions on travel due to epidemic outbreaks or limitations of exchange places. Units obtained from Japanese universities will be recognized as up to 18 Major units. Academic results obtained from Japanese universities will not be included in the calculation of the Major GPA. Students who are unable to obtain the required units in Japanese universities should make up the shortfall by taking courses at 4000 and above level for language courses and all levels for non-language courses after their return to this University.

sections.title: Elective Courses
text: Students may choose to specialize in one of the streams or not to specialize in any stream.

subsections.title: Standard Scheme
text: Students not specializing in any stream are required to take 6 units of 2000 or above level courses from (a) Non-language/(b) language course as listed below, with at least 3 units of 4000 level language course

subsections.title: Local Study Scheme
text: Students not specializing in any stream are required to take 24 units of courses from (a) Non-language courses and (b) Language courses as listed below, with at least 6 units of 2000 or above level courses from (a) Non-language/(b) language course, and at least 3 units of 4000 level courses from (b) language courses

subsections.title: Standard Scheme
text: Students choosing a stream must take 12 units of elective courses specified below. Students are encouraged to declare their stream choice as soon as possible and not later than the summer before their year of graduation.

subsections.title: Local Study Scheme
text: Students choosing a stream must take 24 units of courses with at least four courses from stream elective courses specified below. The remaining units should be taken from non-language elective course section and/or language elective course section as listed in (a) and (b) above. Students are encouraged to declare their stream choice as soon as possible and not later than the summer before their year of graduation.

notes.text: JASP courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Students (i) who cannot fulfill the requirement of Required Courses labeled as * specified under 2 (a) above before the planned year of resident study in Japan; or (ii) who have been put on academic probation at the planned year of resident study in Japan or any time before (regardless of whether the academic probation has been lifted), will not be arranged to participate in the resident study in Japan. These students will be required to complete the major programme requirements by following the Local Study Scheme specified above.

LING1000 which counts towards the fulfillment of the requirements specified in 1 Faculty Package cannot be used for the fulfillment of the requirements specified in 3(a) Non-language Courses and the Japanese Language and Linguistics stream.

Students who have prior knowledge of Japanese before admission may be exempted from taking JASP1470, 1480, 2470 and 2480. They should seek the advice of the Department to take substitute courses in accordance with their academic qualifications as follows:

text: Students who passed placement test and exempted from taking any or all required language course(s) (JASP1470, 1480, 2470 and/or 2480) are required to take corresponding units of Language courses at 3000 or 4000 level specified under 3(b) above, to substitute for the relevant course(s). These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Students who possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N2) qualification when admitted are required to take 18 units of Elective Courses specified under 3 above, with at least 12 units of Language courses at 3000 or 4000 level, to substitute for the four relevant courses. These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Students who possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N1) qualification when admitted are required to take 18 units of Elective Courses specified under 3 above, with at least 9 units of Language courses at 4000 level, to substitute for the four relevant courses. These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Native Japanese students are required to take 18 units of Elective Courses specified under 3 above, with or without any Language courses, to substitute for the four relevant courses. If they choose to take Language courses, they are allowed to take Language courses at 4000 level only, subject to the approval of the course teacher. If they choose to take non-language courses, they should take at least 12 units of elective courses at 2000 or above level.

notes.text: Students are responsible for the extra costs incurred in relation to the resident study in Japan.
These courses are only offered to students before their resident study in Japan.

requirement_schemes.title: Senior-entry Requirement — For Associate Degree or Higher Diploma holders admitted to senior-year places

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 51 units of courses as follows:

subsections.title: Students may choose to specialize in one of the streams or not to specialize in any streams.
Without Stream
text: Students who choose not to specialize in any stream must take 39 units of elective courses from (a) Non-language courses and (b) Language courses below, with at least 12 units of 2000 or above level courses from (a) Non-Language courses and at least 6 units of 4000 level courses from (b) Language courses

subsections.title: With Stream
text: Students choosing a stream must take 39 units of elective courses, including at least four courses from stream elective courses specified below. The remaining units should be taken from non-language elective course section and/or language elective course section as listed in (a) and (b) above, which must include at least 12 units of 2000 or above level courses from (a) Non-Language courses and at least 6 units of 4000 level courses from (b) Language courses. Students are encouraged to declare their stream choice as soon as possible and not later than the summer before their year of graduation.

notes.text: JASP courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Students are required to possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N2) level or equivalent when admitted. They are advised to take Language courses at 3000 or 4000 level in their first year of study and take Language courses at 4000 level in their second year of study. Students who have prior knowledge of Japanese (beyond Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N2) level) before admission should seek the advice of the Department to take substitute courses, as appropriate. Approved courses taken in substitution for other courses will be included in the Major GPA calculation. Students who possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N1) qualification when admitted are only allowed to take courses at 4000 level for Language Courses.
Students are encouraged to join summer exchange programmes organized by the Department.

Students who are interested in doing fieldwork in Japan during optional exchange or conducting a comprehensive final-year project, are encouraged to seek advice from the Department for alternative study pathway.

requirement_schemes.title: Japanese Studies and History Double Major Programme

parts.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 90 units of courses as follows:

sections.title: Faculty Package
text: JASP1090, HIST1000 and any one course from: ANTH1020, ARTS1009, 1010, BMBL1001, CHES1101 or 1102, CHLL1900 or 1902 or 1903, CURE1000 or 1400, 1110, ENGE1000, FAAS1900, HIST1700 or 1701, LING1000, MUSC1000, PHIL1110, THEO1000, TRAN1000

subsections.title: 1st Major: Japanese Studies[b]
text: Students are required to complete 15 units of JASP courses from (a) Non-language courses and (b) Language courses as listed below, with at least 6 units of 2000 or above level courses from (a) Non-language courses and at least 3 units of 4000 level courses from (b) Language courses.

subsections.title: 2nd Major: History
text: Students are required to complete 30 units of HIST courses, including at least 6 units chosen from the courses below:

subsections.title: Other Eligible HIST Courses
text: Other HIST courses may be used to complete this requirement; the stated minimum course rules still apply.

sections.title: Research Component/ Capstone Course/ Final Year Project

notes.text: JASP courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.

Students who have prior knowledge of Japanese before admission may be exempted from taking JASP1470, 1480, 2470 and 2480. They should seek the advice of the Department to take substitute courses in accordance with their academic qualifications as follows:

Students who passed placement test and exempted from taking any or all required language course(s) (JASP1470, 1480, 2470 and/or 2480) are required to take corresponding units of Language courses at 3000 or 4000 level specified under 3(b) above, to substitute for the relevant course(s). These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Students who possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N2) qualification when admitted are required to take 18 units of courses from 3(a) and/or 3(b) above, with at least 12 units of Language Courses at 3000 or 4000 level, to substitute for the four relevant courses. These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Students who possess Japanese Language Proficiency Test (N1) qualification when admitted are required to take 18 units of courses from 3(a) and/or 3(b) above, with at least 9 units of Language Courses at 4000 level, to substitute for the four relevant courses. These substitute courses cannot be double-counted to fulfill the required elective of 3 units of 4000 level language course.

Native Japanese students are required to take 18 units of courses from 3(a) and/or 3(b) above, with or without any Language Courses, to substitute for the four relevant courses. If they choose to take Language Courses, they are allowed to take Language Courses at 4000 level only, subject to the approval of the course teacher. If they choose to take non-language courses, they should take at least 12 units of elective courses at 2000 or above level.Approved courses taken in substitution for JASP1470, 1480, 2470 and 2480 will be included in the Major GPA calculation.
Subject to Department’s approval, native speaker of Japanese can be exempted from the fulfillment of one JASP 4000 level language course, and take 3 units of JASP course as a substitution.
These courses are only offered to students before their resident study in Japan.

LING1000 which counts towards the fulfillment of the requirements specified in 1 Faculty Package cannot be used for the fulfillment of the requirements specified in 3(a) Non-language Courses and the Japanese Language and Linguistics stream.
